card.name: Second drug in a paired combination
card.fires_on: Partway through the second drug or item of a pair joined by 'and' or a slash, such as carbidopa, levodopa or ICS/LABA. It sits where the word 'combination' could otherwise come next.

modes.label: Second drug name in a pair
modes.description: Inside the name of the second drug in a combination product or co-administered pair.

modes.label: Abbreviation in a slash pair
modes.description: Inside a drug-class abbreviation before a slash, as in ICS/LABA.

modes.label: Other paired items
modes.description: Inside a second item in a pair, such as place names or a symptom that goes with another.

card.writes: It lowers 'combination' and 'combined' words, so the text is less likely to say 'combination' right after a pair.
card.plain: It marks the second half of a drug pair, where the text already names the combination and doesn't need the word itself.
